items.label: Cyberpunk Design
items.value: Our laser tag gun with vest features a stunning cyberpunk-inspired design that is sure to turn heads and immerse players in an exciting sci-fi gaming experience.

items.label: Life Indicator Show on Gun & Vest
items.value: Laser Tag Gun Set includes 2 guns and 2 vests. 2 teams can fight with a LED display to see the lives and team data. There are two Way for Gameplay,Gun VS Gun Battle & Gun Vest Battle.Gun and Vest all can choose team clolor,and the team color determined by vest.4 teams to choose from. You can choose favorite mode for fierce and exciting battles.

items.label: Synced Gun and Vest for Ultimate Gaming Experience
items.value: The gun and vest are synced, allowing players to accurately track their health and ammo levels on both the gun and vest. This ensures a seamless and immersive gaming experience with realistic feedback during gameplay.

items.label: Impressive 150ft Shooting Range
items.value: Our Infrared laser tag gun boasts an impressive shooting range of 150ft, allowing players to engage in thrilling long-distance battles and test their marksmanship skills.

items.label: Dual-Sided Lighting for Added Style
items.value: The laser tag gun features dual-sided lighting, adding a cool and unique visual element to the gameplay. The dazzling lights on both sides of the gun make it stand out. Also is perfect gift for 8 9 10 11 12 13 14+ year old boys girls and adults.
